name: Advanced Exposure
description: Exposure ahead of the tone mapping, on its own or beside Basic: Exposure in hundredths of a stop, Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Whites and Blacks, Highlight compression with a threshold, a linear Black level and Midtones; Auto with Average, Centre-weighted, Spot weighted, Highlight priority and Expose to the right modes and an intensity, Shift+double-click auto on single sliders, an Alt-drag clipping view, and exposure matching across a series.
author: Anthony Reimche
